rules.name: ticker_not_null
rules.check: ticker is non-null, non-empty and uppercase normalized

rules.name: date_parseable
rules.check: value parses as YYYY-MM-DD where specified

rules.name: period_parseable
rules.check: period matches YYYY-Q1..Q4 or supported year form and agrees with period_type

rules.name: ohlcv_numeric
rules.check: non-missing OHLCV values are numeric

rules.name: volume_non_negative
rules.check: volume >= 0 when present

rules.name: ohlc_bounds
rules.check: high >= open, close, low and low <= open, close, high when all present

rules.name: minus_one_sentinel
rules.check: -1 is converted to missing with status queried_no_value before analysis

rules.name: null_by_context
rules.check: NULL interpreted using field-specific missing_rule

rules.name: string_boolean
rules.check: only exact normalized True/False strings become booleans; empty remains missing

rules.name: latest_snapshot_filter
rules.check: ticker date equals approved global latest market date for live use
rules.on_fail: mark stale and exclude from live selection

rules.name: stale_ticker_warning
rules.check: latest_price_date lag versus global latest is computed and status warning emitted

rules.name: adjusted_price_uncertainty
rules.check: adjustment status is recorded; long-horizon/corporate-action-sensitive metrics carry warning if unconfirmed

rules.name: bctc_layer_distinction
rules.check: raw item-period-column grain is not concatenated/joined as processed ticker-period grain without explicit transformation

rules.name: metadata_point_in_time
rules.check: current metadata is labeled point_in_time and excluded from backtest unless effective history exists

rules.name: shareholder_no_history
rules.check: shareholder snapshot is labeled no_history and excluded from historical inference/backtest

rules.name: provider_percentage_scale
rules.check: provider scale is identified/normalized before comparison

rules.name: margin_empty_clean
rules.check: empty/NULL is mapped to no_flag according to project convention, not generic missing risk

rules.name: provenance_required
rules.check: source, generated_at, transformation, assumptions and limitations are present

rules.name: cutoff_enforced
rules.check: no observation/update/publication after analysis cutoff is included

rules.name: utf8
rules.check: output is valid UTF-8

limitations: Rules define validation behavior but were not executed against full VNSTOCK data in Phase 3.
Publication-date and corporate-action validations require sources not fully confirmed.
